svg.title: Local Flight widgets and Live Activity for iPhone
svg.desc: Marketing artwork showing the current Local Flight small and medium Home Screen widgets beside the pinned-flight Lock Screen Live Activity, using the layouts and sample data from the native iOS extension.

text.tspan: Pin a flight, scan airport movements,
and follow changes without opening the app.

g.text: Status, route, time, and gate at a glance.
Reads the app’s saved local copy
The extension does not fetch flight data itself.

text.tspan: Illustrative rendering based on the current Local Flight testing extension; appearance varies by iPhone, iOS version, theme, settings, and available data.
Apple, iPhone, iOS, and Live Activities are trademarks of Apple Inc. Local Flight is for informational display and hobby use only—not navigation or safety decisions.
